history.summary: A Shakti shrine at Lakhanpur in Jharsuguda district (CSV town 'Jharsuguda' corrected - the temple is associated with Lakhanpur). Travel write-ups describe it as a centuries-old Odia-style temple celebrating Navratri and Maha Shivaratri, but these accounts are generic and uncited, so the founding date and history are UNVERIFIED. IDENTITY AMBIGUITY (verify): multiple same-named shrines appear in listings - a 'Maa Maheswari Temple' at Laikera, one at Thelkoloi, and a 'Maheswari Temple' with a Bheden (Bargarh district) road project; it is not firmly established which referent the CSV row intends. Coordinates below are approximate, from the Laikera listing.

name: Maheswari Temple
town_description: Lakhanpur is a block and small town in Jharsuguda district, western Odisha, about 25-30 km from Jharsuguda town. It sits in a largely rural, forested landscape and is known regionally for the Koilighugar waterfall. Like the rest of the district it lies in the mineral-rich Ib valley belt.

travel.airport: Veer Surendra Sai Airport, Jharsuguda (~35-40 km, verify)
travel.road: Reachable by road from Jharsuguda via the Lakhanpur road (verify)
